captureMode: sequential: retail fully closed before the candidate starts, both at level5, windowed

remaining_difference.assessment: The two binaries link the same logic at different offsets, so comparing image-relative VAs directly is not a valid equivalence test. The candidate slot does hold a live code pointer to the Flow phase-1 handler, which is the behaviour the native provides.

fixes_that_produced_this: Clamped the DirectDraw blit destination into the primary surface; the candidate previously aborted with DDERR_INVALIDRECT (0x88760096) on frame one.

Set dispatch_table_index to QTask_FlowClassId instead of QTask_GameClassId. Retail Flow_Start 0x00402070 stores arg_4h to 0x00567C8C and calls 0x004018F0, so the dispatch record belongs to Flow (125), not Game (124). This also raised the candidate from 8 to 26.8 FPS because the real per-frame handler now runs.
Corrected the probe table base from table+0x180 bytes to table+0x600: task_phase_stride is 0x180 ELEMENTS of FrameHandler, and a FrameHandler is a 4-byte function pointer.
Made capture sequential and resolved candidate symbols from the built image instead of hardcoded stale addresses.
consequence: Three of four typed observables now agree and the fourth differs only because the comparison compares raw VAs across two separately linked images. 0x00401050 stays STRUCTURALLY_VERIFIED until the comparison is made symbol-aware and the runtime contract is re-derived.
